A ship that was once the fastest in the world and is longer than the Titanic has intentionally been sunk off the coast of Florida, turning into the world's largest artificial ocean reef.
The SS United States spent nearly 30 years docked in Philadelphia before it was moved to Florida, where it will become a home for sealife and an underwater attraction for marine enthusiasts.
Activists unsuccessfully fought for the historic liner - which crossed the Atlantic Ocean hundreds of times - to be preserved as a museum.
Instead, after being purchased by a Florida county, it was added to the dozens of artificial reefs off the coast, with a land-based museum detailing the ship's history also planned.
Before its retirement, the SS United States was known for carrying royalty and celebrities between the US and Europe, beginning in 1952 and ending in 1969.
A young Bill Clinton, before he was president, used the ship to cross the Atlantic. Former presidents Harry Truman, Dwight Eisenhower and John Kennedy also travelled on the vessel.
The ship was moved from Philadelphia to Alabama last year for cleaning and remediation work.
On Monday, it took its final journey from Alabama to the coast of Destin, Florida, where it was sunk on Wednesday in a precision operation without explosives.
This archival video shows the SS United States in 2025 as it starts its move to Florida on its way to become the world's largest artificial reef.
Stars including Marlon Brando, Coco Chanel, Duke Ellington, Salvador Dali, Walt Disney, Judy Garland and Cary Grant also boarded the ship during its sailing lifetime.
Before its purchase by the municipal Florida government, a number of proposals that would have seen the ship live a second life as a museum or a floating hotel failed.
Instead, it sat at various docks with various owners as legal battles played out.
The SS United States Conservancy group repeatedly attempted to keep the ship above water, but was unsuccessful.
Conservancy President Susan Gibbs - whose grandfather helped design the liner - said she was glad that the story of the SS United States would live on.
"[The ship] has always been this unabashedly American symbol that brings so many people together," Gibbs told CBS News, the BBC's US partner.

Yapay zeka çip girişimi Fractile , 720 milyon dolar yatırım aldı. Şirketin 720 milyon dolarlık C serisi yatırım turuna Thrive Capital , F ounders Fund , Lightspeed Venture Partners ve Redpoint ortaklaşa liderlik etti.
İngiltere merkezli Fractile'ın yatırım turunda CapitalG, DST Global, Elad Gil, BlackRock, Bain Capital Ventures, T. Rowe Price, SV Angel, Sovereign AI, British Business Bank, Shopify Ventures, Felicis, Gigascale Capital, 20VC, Georgian ve Balderton yer aldı .
2022 yılında kurulan şirketin değerlemesi 7 milyar dolara yükseldi. Fractile, yeni aldığı yatırımı yapay zeka modellerinin yanıt üretme süreçlerini hızlandıran çiplerini geliştirmek ve ilk ticari çipini 2027 yılında piyasaya sürmek için kullanmayı planlıyor.
Oxford Üniversitesi Robotics Institute araştırmacısı Walter Goodwin tarafından kurulan Fractile, yapay zeka modellerinin çıkarım (inference) süreçlerinde ihtiyaç duyduğu işlem gücünü sağlamak üzere özel çipler geliştiriyor. Çıkarım süreci, bir yapay zeka modelinin eğitiminin ardından kullanıcıdan gelen bir komutu veya soruyu işleyerek yanıt üretmesini ifade ediyor. Bu süreçte modellerin büyük miktarda veriyi hızlı bir şekilde işlemesi gerekiyor.
Fractile de tam bu noktada devreye girerek, yapay zeka modellerinin daha kısa sürede yanıt üretmesini sağlayacak donanımlar üzerinde çalışıyor. Şirketin geliştirdiği çipler, özellikle yapay zeka modellerinin çalıştırılması sırasında ortaya çıkan yüksek işlem maliyetlerini ve enerji tüketimini azaltmayı hedefliyor.
Fractile, mevcut donanımlara kıyasla daha hızlı çıkarım performansı sunarak yapay zeka uygulamalarının daha verimli çalışmasını amaçlıyor. Nvidia gibi şirketlerin öne çıktığı yapay zeka donanımı pazarında alternatif bir teknoloji geliştirmeye odaklanan girişim, ilk ticari ürününü 2027 yılında kullanıma sunmayı hedefliyor.
Fractile'in geçen Mayıs ayında 220 milyon dolar yatırım aldığını hatırlatalım .

Medical staff inspect damage to Nasser Hospital after it was hit by an Israeli airstrike overnight in Khan Younis, Gaza Strip on Thursday. Abdel Kareem Hana/AP hide caption
KHAN YOUNIS, Gaza Strip — An Israeli airstrike targeting the Nasser Hospital in southern Gaza killed six people, including a general surgeon, and wounded at least 28 more, Gaza's Health Ministry said.
The strike was carried out early Thursday, according to the Israeli military, which said it struck a Hamas commander and other militants, without providing evidence.
The Gaza Health Ministry said the strike hit the hospital's surgical wing and that a doctor, Rizk Abu Shaira, was among the dead. Inside the building, parts of several floors were either severely damaged or destroyed. Debris was scattered across hospital beds and equipment, and rebar dangled from the ceiling where the munition had penetrated.
British surgeon Goher Rahbour, who is volunteering at Nasser Hospital, said that the strike occurred just after midnight and shook the whole building.
"It was extremely smoky," said Rahbour, who was on the fourth floor of the surgical department when the bomb hit. The recovery area on the same floor was reduced to rubble, he said.
He said he had been operating alongside Abu Shaira just hours before the strike. "Lovely guy, happy and smiling," he said.
Nasser Hospital in the city of Khan Younis is one of the few functioning medical facilities left in Gaza, whose healthcare infrastructure has been decimated by a yearslong war.
The Israeli military has raided or laid siege to hospitals across Gaza, accusing Hamas of using them as command centers and to hide fighters. It has also destroyed medical equipment and supplies and killed or detained hundreds of healthcare workers.
In armed conflict, hospitals and their staff are protected under international humanitarian law. A hospital can lose its protected status, however, if it is used for military purposes.
In a statement on Thursday, the military said Hamas had "established a presence within the hospital complex" and that the commander had turned it "into a headquarters."
Israeli forces have previously attacked Nasser Hospital. In 2025, the military killed five journalists — including AP contributor Mariam Dagga — when it struck a gathering point for local reporters at the complex.
The war in Gaza started on Oct. 7, 2023, when Hamas-led militants attacked southern Israel, killing around 1,200 people and taking 251 others hostage. Since then, Israel's retaliatory offensive has killed more than 74,600 people, according to the Gaza Health Ministry, which is part of the Hamas-run government but whose figures are generally considered reliable by the international community.
Israel has continued to strike Gaza despite a U.S.-backed ceasefire and controls at least 60% of the enclave. Since the truce went into effect in October 2025, Israeli strikes and gunfire have killed 1,622 people, health authorities say. Five Israeli soldiers have also been killed during that period.

OpenAI 'ın gelirlerindeki hızlı büyüme devam ediyor. Bloomberg'ün konuya yakın kaynaklara dayandırdığı bilgilere göre şirketin 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğindeki geliri 10 milyar doların üzerine çıktı . OpenAI, yılın ikinci çeyreğinde 6,7 milyar dolar gelir elde etmişti. Böylece şirketin geliri, bir önceki çeyreğe göre yaklaşık yüzde 50 arttı. Gelir artışında OpenAI'ın yeni yapay zeka modellerine yönelik güçlü talebin etkili olduğu belirtiliyor. Şirketin yılın ilk ve ikinci çeyreği arasındaki gelir artışı yaklaşık yüzde 18 seviyesindeydi. Üçüncü çeyrekte kaydedilen büyüme, OpenAI'ın gelir artış hızının da yeniden yükseldiğine işaret ediyor.
Gelir tarafındaki büyümeye rağmen OpenAI'ın operasyon giderleri de yüksek seviyesini koruyor. The Information'ın aktardığı verilere göre şirketin ikinci çeyrekte 10,1 milyar dolar olan operasyon zararı, üçüncü çeyrekte 10,9 milyar dolara yükseldi. Buna karşılık şirketin düzeltilmiş faaliyet kâr marjı, yüzde -150'den yüzde -109'a yükseldi. Bu da şirketin gelirlerine kıyasla daha az zarar ettiğini gösteriyor.
OpenAI'ın yıllıklandırılmış gelirinin de 50 milyar dolara ulaştığı belirtiliyor. Şirket son dönemde fiyatlandırma değişiklikleri, indirimler ve kurumsal kullanıma yönelik ürünlerin yanı sıra görevleri kullanıcı adına yerine getiren yapay zeka ajanlarına daha fazla odaklanıyor.
Şirketin ücretli ChatGPT kullanıcı sayısının ise yaklaşık 100 milyona yükseldiği aktarılıyor. Bu rakamın ChatGPT'nin haftalık aktif kullanıcılarının yaklaşık yüzde 8,5'ine karşılık geldiği ve ikinci çeyreğe kıyasla hafif bir artış gösterdiği belirtiliyor. PRESS REVIEW – Thursday, November 12: We look at reactions from Spain after the country's first nationwide general strike in 14 years. It comes two weeks before snap general elections. Also: Scott Colom makes history as the first Black senator in Mississippi in 145 years after an epic Senate midterm race finally concluded. Finally, fans of Barça will be able to inter their ashes at Camp Nou as part of a new offer by the club to allow supporters to cheer on the team in the afterlife.
Wednesday saw Spain 's first 24-hour strike in 14 years. Hundreds of thousands of protesters marched through the streets of Barcelona , Madrid and other cities. It comes a fortnight ahead of a general election that will pit Socialist Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez against a strong right-wing opposition. El Periodico, the centre-left Catalan daily, calls it a "different kind of strike". The Madrid version of 20 Minutos says the strike filled the streets but did not paralyse the country. It laments, however, that 15 days before the election, the demonstration does not allow enough time for dialogue to solve the housing crisis and properly address the demands of protesters. El Pais headlines with a warning from major unions : they will continue protesting if the future government cuts pensions or public services. In its editorial, El Pais says the November 11 movement should not be "mistaken as a momentary expression of frustrations. Voters will pun­ish those who take excep­tion to the mobil­isa­tion instead of debat­ing the reas­ons that motiv­ate it".
In the US , papers report on a historic victory in the Mississippi Senate race. Democrat Scott Colom has won the seat, several days after midterm elections in the US. He is the first Black senator ever directly elected by the voters of Mississippi. He'll be the first Black Senator to serve since 1881, Time magazine notes. The local news outlet Mississippi Today hails Colom's win on the front of its website. It notes that Mississippi – or rather "Messy-ssippi" – has a history of elections that don't end on Election Day. The 1999 governor's race in the state dragged on until the new millennium. The paper also tells us the strange story of 2015, when a race for the House Seat ended in a tie between a Democratic incumbent and a Republican challenger. It was decided quite literally by a drawing of straws – with the incumbent picking the winning straw!
Finally, the Guardian reports that fans of football team Barcelona will soon have the opportunity to inter their ashes at the stadium. The Guardian says die-hard supporters of Barcelona – pun intended – will be able to cheer on the club in their afterlife. The club is upgrading its Camp Nou venue and will include now a memorial with 26,000 niches where fans can deposit their ashes after they call full time on their life. Being an afterlife supporter will cost you – €6,000 for 50 years or €10,000 for eternity – but there will be annual maintenance fees and if you want a plaque, you'll have to fork out for that too. But for some, it's a small price to pay to cheer the club's goals from beyond the grave!
You can catch our press review every morning on France 24 at 7:20am and 9:20am (Paris time), from Monday to Friday.
